preconditions.description: The number of greetings must be between 1 and 750.
Each greeting must be a non-empty string.
The total length of all greetings must not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the maximum size of the stylish set.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(ribbon) <= n for ribbon in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line of output must contain valid ribbon indices from 1 to n.
The number of unique ribbon indices in the output must equal the maximum size of the stylish set.
